description.value:
Slot none; Price 10,000 gp (lesser), 20,000 gp (normal), 40,000 gp (greater)
Weight 3 lbs.; Feat Cost 2 sp

Spells affected by this feat have a reduced manifestation. Being subjected to the effect requires a Perception check (DC 15 + 1/2 your caster level) or the target does not perceive the presence and source of the effect. For each (sensory) talent you possess, improve the Perception check DC by an additional +2 and hide sensation associated with that (sensory) talent. This has no effect on spells or sphere abilities that rely on a suppressed sensation(s) to function, but you may always forgo the +2 bonus to the Perception DC to allow the sensation of the effect to function normally.

Construction Requirements
Craft Apparatus, Suppressed Spell; Cost 5,000 gp (lesser), 10,000 gp (normal), 20,000 gp (greater)

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
description.instructions:
Selected profile: lesser tier; held slender rod. Apply as part of casting a qualifying sphere effect of caster level seven or lower. Hold this apparatus in at least one hand while applying it. Spend one of three daily uses; only one metamagic apparatus may apply per casting. Its feat's extra spell-point and casting-time costs are waived, but normal effect and other-metamagic costs still apply.

Published weight is three pounds. Perception DC is 15 + half your caster level, plus an optional two per sensory talent possessed, hiding its associated sensation. Effects relying on a suppressed sensation do not function through that suppression; forgo its optional bonus when needed. Do not impose a general Perception penalty or conceal every actor effect.

Shared metamagic apparatus rules. Feat Cost applies to taking the feat, not using the physical apparatus.
